boards.title: Your First Weekend at Thomas Aquinas College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A campus-centered first-weekend sequence using named California-campus places and documented activities.

cards.title: Start at Founders Plaza
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival • California campus
cards.notes: Use the campus map to locate the plaza and identify the academic-side landmarks before meeting classmates or heading to your next campus stop.
cards.short_summary: A named campus-map landmark for beginning your orientation walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Thomas Aquinas College’s California campus map identifies Founders Plaza as a parking and recreation landmark.
cards.source_title: California Campus Map | Thomas Aquinas College
cards.access_notes: Follow College directions and campus access guidance.

cards.title: Share a meal at St. Joseph Commons
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • campus dining
cards.notes: Make this a low-pressure first conversation: sit with someone new, compare weekend plans, and use the meal as a natural reset after arrival.
cards.short_summary: The campus map names St. Joseph Commons, including the Skinner Coffee Shop.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s California campus map lists St. Joseph Commons and the Ken & Joyce Skinner Coffee Shop.
cards.source_title: California Campus Map | Thomas Aquinas College
cards.access_notes: Dining availability and eligibility are determined by the College.

cards.entity_name: Our Lady of the Most Holy Trinity Chapel
cards.title: Pause at the Chapel
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • academic quadrangle
cards.notes: Take a quiet look at the chapel from the quadrangle, or attend a service if it fits the College’s posted schedule and your own practice.
cards.short_summary: A prominent chapel at the head of the academic quadrangle.
cards.evidence_claim: Our Lady of the Most Holy Trinity Chapel stands at the head of the academic quadrangle on the California campus.
cards.source_title: Our Lady of the Most Holy Trinity Chapel | Thomas Aquinas College
cards.access_notes: Mass and other chapel access follow College scheduling and guidance.

cards.title: Find St. Cecilia Hall
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • campus events venue
cards.notes: Locate the lecture and concert hall early, then check official College communications for any open lecture, concert, or scheduled community program.
cards.short_summary: A named California-campus venue for lectures and concerts.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s California campus map lists St. Cecilia Lecture & Concert Hall.
cards.source_title: California Campus Map | Thomas Aquinas College
cards.access_notes: Attend only events announced by the College and open to you.

cards.title: Learn the Library layout
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning • study setup
cards.notes: Walk through the library and choose a study spot for a short reading session; save questions about borrowing or services for library staff.
cards.short_summary: A named library on the College’s California campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s California campus map identifies the St. Bernardine of Siena Library.
cards.source_title: California Campus Map | Thomas Aquinas College
cards.access_notes: Library access and borrowing policies are set by the College.

cards.entity_name: Pope St. John Paul II Athletic Center
cards.title: Tour the Athletic Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • recreation option
cards.notes: See which spaces are available, then join an appropriate activity or make a plan for a future workout with classmates rather than assuming open access.
cards.short_summary: The 2022 athletic center includes courts, weight rooms, climbing walls, and a pool.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says its California Pope St. John Paul II Athletic Center has basketball courts, weight rooms, climbing and bouldering walls, and an outdoor swimming pool.
cards.access_notes: Use facilities only under current College rules and scheduled availability.

cards.title: Join a field-side game
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • outdoor recreation
cards.notes: Bring comfortable shoes, check whether a field is in use, and join an organized or casual game only when the group and space are available.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed outdoor field complements the College’s intramural program.
cards.evidence_claim: The California campus map lists an athletic field, and the College describes intramural sports including soccer, flag football, volleyball, basketball, and tennis.
cards.access_notes: Field use is subject to College scheduling and activity rules.

cards.title: Take a plaza break
cards.subtitle: Saturday late afternoon • campus walk
cards.notes: Use this named plaza as a brief outdoor pause between activities, keeping the visit simple: talk, review your schedule, and head to the next stop together.
cards.short_summary: A named plaza shown on the official California campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: Thomas Aquinas College’s California campus map identifies St. Gladys Plaza as a parking and recreation landmark.
cards.source_title: California Campus Map | Thomas Aquinas College
cards.access_notes: Use normal campus pathways and follow College guidance.

cards.title: Walk by the Hacienda Ponds
cards.subtitle: Saturday daylight • map-listed landmark
cards.notes: Include the ponds on a daylight campus walk, staying on permitted routes and treating them as a scenic landmark rather than a recreation area.
cards.short_summary: The official campus map labels the Hacienda ponds.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s California campus map lists Hacienda ponds among its parking and recreation landmarks.
cards.source_title: California Campus Map | Thomas Aquinas College
cards.access_notes: Stay on allowed campus routes and follow posted safety guidance near water.

cards.title: Finish with the Ranch Hiking Loop
cards.subtitle: Sunday daylight • campus ranch property
cards.notes: Go with companions during daylight, use the approved access points, and give wildlife space; choose another activity if conditions or College guidance say so.
cards.short_summary: A College-permitted loop by the Painter’s Shack and avocado orchard.
cards.evidence_claim: The California Code of Conduct permits students, faculty, and staff to run or hike the loop by the Painter’s Shack and avocado orchard, only during daylight; it strongly discourages hiking alone.
cards.source_title: California Code of Conduct | Thomas Aquinas College
cards.access_notes: Daylight only; do not hike alone. Observe College restrictions and wildlife safety guidance.
